name: skill-local
description: 동료들과 공유하는 Claude Code 플러그인 마켓플레이스 — 각 스킬은 자기 레포에서 독립적으로 유지보수된다.

plugins.name: skill-cure
plugins.description: Triage and remediate security-scan / SAST findings on skills or repos: routes each finding (command-injection, exec/eval, oversized files, description limits, low analyzability, cross-skill shared URL/pattern) to a per-issue reference doc with proven fixes and verification.

plugins.name: statusline-kit
plugins.description: Install a Claude Code statusline (model, cwd/branch, context usage, session token totals) into a fresh environment.

plugins.name: agent-clinic
plugins.description: Diagnose and treat a repo's context/doc health: trim bloated CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, resync public docs with the current code, untrack leaked editor config, and clear out finished planning artifacts.

plugins.name: resolve-conflict
plugins.description: Resolve merge conflicts and silent auto-merge inconsistencies when syncing a fork with upstream.

plugins.name: git-sweep
plugins.description: Find and clean up unnecessary git worktrees and branches — merged (including squash-merged PRs) or otherwise safe to remove — with merge evidence shown before anything is deleted.

plugins.name: gateway-migration
plugins.description: System LSI사업부 LLM Gateway 전환(8/18 07:00 KST) 무인 셋업 — 전환 시각 이후 여는 다음 터미널에서 설치→setup→login→verify를 자동으로 이어서 진행한다.

plugins.name: aws-login
plugins.description: AWS SSO 자동 로그인 셋업 — Claude Code 세션 중 자격증명 만료로 반복 로그인하는 문제를 자동 갱신으로 해결한다.

plugins.name: github-workflow
plugins.description: GitHub Issue 기반 작업 세션 워크플로우 — 이슈 선택→worktree→브랜치→테스트→PR→Project 보드 상태 자동화.

plugins.name: skill-optimizer
plugins.description: Slim down and structurally optimize SKILL.md files for token efficiency without regressing behavior, trigger coverage, inbound anchors, or information.

plugins.name: plugin-packager
plugins.description: 스킬/레포를 Claude Code 마켓플레이스·플러그인으로 패키징·개조해 /plugin 으로 설치 가능하게 하고 실제 설치까지 검증한다 (GHES 포함).

plugins.name: avatar-onboarding
plugins.description: Turn an Agent Factory Avatar Card into an installed personal Claude Code, OpenCode, or Codex subagent — interviews for missing operational context, proposes Card changes, and installs the reviewed profile.

plugins.name: agent-factory-api
plugins.description: Use when registering, updating, searching, or deleting Agent Factory assets through the agent REST API, including skills, avatar or agent cards, roles, tasks, task-skill links, skill versions, component visibility, aft_ API keys, or https://agent.samsungds.net:3355/api/docs.

plugins.name: bedrock-cost-report
plugins.description: Generate a monthly Claude Code / AWS Bedrock cost report as a self-contained HTML file. Fetches the user's own usage automatically from the DS Bedrock dashboard API (no input needed), or takes a pasted AICM CSV row / billed total. Use when the user asks to break down their Claude Code cost by model / project / task and get cost-saving insights.
